name: Lunhowl: Co-op Horror
detailed_description:
Dive into Lunhowl: Coop Horror, a spine-chilling first-person survival horror experience blending intense co-op action with psychological dread. Set in a forsaken factory, you and your team must navigate a labyrinth of dark corridors, manage dwindling energy resources, and survive encounters with unsettling mascots lurking in the shadows. Your mission? Prepare food to appease these creatures and keep them docile while racing against time to survive each grueling day.

In a gripping 6-7 day campaign, every choice matters. As you progress, earn skill points to customize your team’s abilities, chosen by the team captain, to adapt to increasingly difficult challenges. Maintain your sanity as the atmosphere grows heavier and the mascots become more aggressive. For added fun, discover interactive objects like boomboxes to lighten the mood—or crank up the tension.

Complete the campaign to unlock Nightmare Mode, a brutal survival challenge that pushes your skills to the limit. With its haunting atmosphere, cooperative multiplayer gameplay, and indie charm, Lunhowl: Coop Horror delivers a heart-pounding experience for fans of survival horror and mascot-driven terror. Add it to your wishlist and prepare for the nightmare ahead!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 veya AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 veya AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX uyumlu ses kartı
  • Additional Notes: İnternet bağlantısı gereklidir (çevrimiçi bir oyun olduğu için)
